content: Hi! This is Tom! Can I speak to Lily?
Sorry. She isn't in at the moment. Can I take a message?

Could you please tell her not to wait for me this evening? We planned to go to a party together, but something important came up and I have to rush off. I'll be back in Cairo at the beginning of next week.
Right. I'll tell her. Are you leaving now?
Yes, I leave at half past two. Please give my love to her. Thank you!
Could you ask her to phone me when she gets in?
Sure. You'd better give me your number.
